{
  "name": "nuet",
  "version": "0.1.2",
  "description": "A dim time above each prompt and each reply in the Claude Code transcript, written the way your own clock setting writes it",
  "author": {
    "name": "Mark Medum Bundgaard",
    "url": "https://github.com/mmedum"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/mmedum/nuet",
  "repository": "https://github.com/mmedum/nuet",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/nuet#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/nuet/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/nuet#privacy",
  "userConfig": {
    "seconds": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Seconds",
      "description": "Show seconds in each time; a strftime time format decides for itself",
      "default": false
    },
    "timeColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time color",
      "description": "A theme role such as inactive (the default, Claude Code's color for hints and timestamps), claude or success; or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan",
      "default": "inactive"
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "transcript",
    "timestamps",
    "time",
    "tui"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
